goblin hunter.accept_text:
These goblins are really annoying - they keep robbing shops
in nearby cities and there's just no end to them.
Care to lend me a hand? I'll reward you if you slay ten of them.
goblin hunter.report_text: Oh, you managed to slay them? Good job! Here's your reward, as I promised.

ogre hunter.accept_text: Hey, I heard you've truly been a nightmare for these Orks. However, there's something stronger than them... Yeah, Ogres! There's a rumor that there is one in our lands. If you manage to defeat it... Well, I'll reward you with a new skill! What would you say?
ogre hunter.report_text: Wow, you really managed to defeat him! That's great! Here's your new skill - it deals increased damage and may stun the target if you land a good hit... Put it to a good use!
